steps.title: Stocks leaderboard — Proven badges across all 120 rows
steps.narration: The Stocks leaderboard ranks every security by its factor scores. The Leadership column carries a bright teal 'Proven' chip on every single row, marking the one signal that has passed rigorous out-of-sample testing. Entry Quality and Risk show a quieter grey 'Not yet proven' chip — honest about what has not yet been certified.
steps.point_out: The health badge in the header reads 'Ready'. Every row in the Leadership column glows teal-green, while Entry Quality and Risk stay a muted grey.

steps.title: Stock detail for MU — three score cards
steps.narration: Clicking any ticker opens its score card page. MU shows three cards: Leadership graded A at 94.58, Entry Quality, and Risk. Only the Leadership card carries the teal 'Proven' badge — the other two are honestly marked 'Not yet proven', keeping the display accurate rather than overpromising.
steps.point_out: Three score cards are visible on the page. Only Leadership shows 'Proven'. Entry Quality and Risk show 'Not yet proven'. No error message and no blank screen.

steps.title: Why proven? — the out-of-sample proof panel
steps.narration: Clicking 'Why proven?' on the Leadership card reveals the complete statistical evidence: a PASS verdict, +6.36% holdout edge, p-value near 0.0005 across 12,297 observations, all measured against the SPY benchmark. This is the full proof chain shown in plain language, not marketing copy.
steps.point_out: The expanded panel shows PASS, +6.36%, p ≈ 0.0005, n = 12,297, and 'vs SPY'. All values are drawn live from the API.

steps.title: Evidence ledger — certified claim for leadership_score
steps.narration: Inside the proof panel, 'View backing evidence row' jumps straight to the Evidence ledger, anchored to the leadership_score certified claim. The row shows all five required fields: the hypothesis statement, PASS verdict, +6.36% holdout edge, SPY benchmark control, and registration date — nothing blank, nothing placeholder.
steps.point_out: The ledger row shows the full hypothesis text, PASS verdict, +6.36% edge, VS SPY, and registration date 2026-06-30. Every field is populated.

steps.title: Round-trip complete — back to the leaderboard
steps.narration: Clicking 'Backs: Stocks leaderboard' on the evidence row returns you to the full ranked list with no broken links and no missing data. The complete circuit — leaderboard, stock detail, proof panel, evidence ledger, back to leaderboard — closes cleanly in five steps.
steps.point_out: You are back on the /stocks leaderboard. Leadership shows teal 'Proven' chips across all 120 rows, exactly as when the tour started.
